Appendix B. Operational database schema and indexes

Schema snapshot only: no table rows were read for this reference. Defaults and declared constraints are copied as schema, not inferred behavior. SQLite declarations and enabled foreign-key enforcement are separate concerns. Source initialization/migrations can add columns to older databases.
